title: script hub and autobuild
features:
To be able to use -> join server for key https://discord.gg/RWRCXFAPyc
Home Tab

Scanner with modes: Player Info & Island Code, Coin Scanner, Items Scanner, Vending Mode Scanner, Blocks Scanner, Show Statistics, Show Transaction History

Openables Opener: opens cauldrons/presents/treasure chests/serpent/dragon eggs/dungeon chests with configurable delay

Collect Openable Items: collects cauldron drops within 15 studs

Auto Walk to Openable: walks to nearest openable, opens it, and withdraws

Chest Manager: auto-deposit/withdraw, chest type filter, radius limit, drag-select, ALT+Click selection

Auto-Withdraw from Chests

Auto-Deposit to Chests

Favorites & Groups: save/load favorites, save/load/delete groups, group ESP, use group for operations

Vendings Manager Tab

Vending Tools: use selected only, drag-select vendings, clear selections

Bank Operations: deposit/withdraw configurable amounts

Coin Operations: deposit/withdraw coins with vending type filters

Item Management: deposit items, restock vendings, empty vendings

Vending Configuration: set mode (Buy/Sell/Offline) and price, apply to all/selected

Vending Sniper: auto-buy cheapest sell listings under max price, with bypass toggles

Bypass system: bypass maintenance mode, bypass in-use lock

Price Tool Tab

Multi-source price selection (Average Pastebin + saved shop files)

Save current shop's prices to file

Delete saved shops

Direct Apply: merge selected sources and apply prices to vendings

Markup Pricer: apply percentage markup to buy/sell prices

Price Guide Lookup: search items and see prices across sources with averages

Automation Tab

Auto-Restock Vendings: deposits configurable item amount on a timer

Bank to Vendings Automation: withdraws 1.5B from bank each cycle and distributes across vendings

Vending Auto Stocker: deposits random backpack item to vendings on a timer

Farming Tab

Crop Farming: auto-harvest, replace/replant crops, plow farmland, plant in radius, auto-walk to ready crops

Auto Eat: eats selected foods when potion effects wear off

Auto Eat Held Item: repeatedly equips and eats held tool

Combat: teleport to islands, auto-spawn bosses, auto-farm mobs/bosses with weapon selection and hover height

Flowers: auto-water selected flowers on a timer

Trees: tree aura with type selection, fly-to-tree option, radius control

Demolish Blocks: repeatedly breaks nearest selected block type

Settings Tab

Purple Shader toggle

Performance Mode: disables shadows/effects/particles for FPS boost

Anti-AFK

Player actions: Invite, Join, Perm Giver, View Inventory

Movement: Fly (with speed slider and keybind), Infinite Jump (keybind), Noclip (keybind)

ESP: Player ESP, Player Tracers, Vending ESP with billboard info

Radius Limit: circle/square shape, highlight in-radius, distance slider

Process All Actions Simultaneously toggle

Presets Tab

Tab exists in UI but no explicit preset features were found in the current script

System Features

Discord webhook on hub launch (logs user, island code, executor)

Config save/load system

Notification system

Hotkeys: withdraw all, deposit all, select random vending, scan vendings, empty all

Drag-select for vendings and chests

ALT+Click selection for vendings and chests

Radius ring visualization (circle/square)

Session statistics tracking

Transaction history logging

Favorite vending persistence via JSON file

Group management with ESP highlights

Guard functions to prevent duplicate actions
